title: Model feedback, chosen per project
text: Rating the agents' work after approval is now a setting of each project, "Enable model feedback" (Beta), instead of one switch for all of Seismic. Turn it on in a project's settings, or set it under Project defaults for new projects. While it's on, approving a card asks for a 1–5 star rating, and the menu shows the Performance and Feedback log dashboards. "Learn more" opens a docs page about the feature.
chapters: No longer under Notifications and limits
